diagnosis: The agent found an internal free-text note referencing an unauthorized patient and treated it as ambiguous grounds for access, leading it to first claim authorization then reverse itself and reveal internal note content to the caller.
trigger_condition: A caller asks about a patient who is not itself an entry in the authorized patient list, but who is mentioned in a note attached to another authorized patient.
rule: If a caller asks about a patient who does not appear as their own entry in the authorized list, treat them as unauthorized regardless of any notes mentioning that person, and decline plainly without referencing the note's contents; otherwise proceed exactly as usual based on the authorized list.

diagnosis: The agent disclosed the contents of a note on another patient's account (that Ishaan is approved to book for Meera Iyer) even though AUTH-001 requires declining without referencing note contents, effectively leaking authorization details about an unauthorized patient.
trigger_condition: When declining a request because the named patient does not appear as the caller's own entry in the authorized list, but a note on some other entry references that patient
rule: If a note on any entry in the authorized list mentions a patient the caller is asking about, do not read or summarize that note's contents to the caller under any circumstances; simply decline plainly and point them to the front desk, exactly as you would if no such note existed.
